meta.name: pptx
meta.description: Use this skill any time a .pptx or .potx file is involved in any way — as input, output, or both. This includes: creating slide decks, pitch decks, or presentations; reading, parsing, or extracting text from any .pptx or .potx file (even if the extracted content will be used elsewhere, like in an email or summary); editing, modifying, or updating existing presentations; combining or splitting slide files; working with templates (.potx), layouts, speaker notes, or comments. Trigger whenever the user mentions "deck," "slides," "presentation," or references a .pptx or .potx filename, regardless of what they plan to do with the content afterward. If a .pptx or .potx file needs to be opened, created, or touched, use this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建、编辑和提取演示文稿内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要处理 .pptx 或 .potx 格式的演示文稿文件
copy.tagline_en: Create, edit, and extract content from presentations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to work with .pptx or .potx presentation files

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能直接处理 PowerPoint 文件：新建演示文稿、读取 .pptx/.potx 里的文字与结构、修改现有幻灯片、套用模板，并保证生成的文件可正常打开。
howto.when: 当你提供或提到 .pptx/.potx 文件，或说出“deck”“slides”“presentation”等词，并要求创建、读取、编辑或套用模板时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个10页的新产品发布PPT，用深色商务风格。
say.note: 会生成一个新的 .pptx 演示文稿。

say.text: 把这份 deck.pptx 每页的文字整理成大纲。
say.note: 会先读取文件，再按页返回内容。

say.text: 用 template.potx 模板把这几个段落排成片子。
say.note: 会基于模板生成排好版的新 pptx。

howto.what_en: Turns Claude into a PowerPoint handler: it can create decks, read text from .pptx/.potx files, edit existing slides, and apply template layouts while keeping files valid.
howto.when_en: Triggers whenever a .pptx/.potx file is provided or mentioned, including the words "deck", "slides", or "presentation", and creating, reading, editing, or templating slides is requested.

say_en.text: Create a 10-slide product launch PPT in a dark business style.
say_en.note: A new .pptx file will be produced.

say_en.text: Turn each slide of this deck.pptx into an outline.
say_en.note: It reads the file first and returns per-slide content.

say_en.text: Lay out these paragraphs with the template.potx.
say_en.note: It builds a formatted pptx from the template.
